fact: Mixx by Yas carries traffic fine payments and Stone Town Municipal Authority parking payments in Zanzibar, the firm says.
The Bank of Tanzania governor says electronic payments are increasingly used for government services through control numbers.

The Mandatory Electronic Payments for Specified Transactions Order, in force from 1 July 2026, requires fees, charges, levies, tolls, fares and parking to be paid electronically, with covered businesses given six months to set up compliant systems.
